panels.title: Accounts with a schedule, of all accounts

targets.rawSql: select count(*) filter (where schedule is not null) as scheduled, count(*) as "all accounts" from game_accounts

panels.title: Runs ended by a closing window, per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '1d', 0), count(*) as runs from bot_runs where end_reason = 'schedule' and $__timeFilter(ended_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Scheduled accounts by current state
panels.description: Asleep means wanted, stopped, and the last run ended because its window closed. Whether a window is open now is worked out in JS (scheduleState) and isn't in Postgres.

targets.rawSql: select case when a.desired_state = 'running' and s.actual_state = 'stopped' and last_run.end_reason = 'schedule' then 'asleep: window closed' when s.actual_state is null then 'never started' else s.actual_state::text end as state, a.desired_state as wanted, count(*) as accounts from game_accounts a left join bot_status s on s.account_id = a.id left join lateral (select r.end_reason from bot_runs r where r.account_id = a.id order by r.started_at desc limit 1) last_run on true where a.schedule is not null group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc
